label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is param (user-provided value) which is assigned to bar and then passed to toCharArray(...). The user input from the Referer header flows through URL decoding and map retrieval to the bar variable, which is then used as the argument to response.getWriter().write(bar.toCharArray(), 0, length). Since param is directly used in the sink expression, it is attacker-controlled and leads to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from Referer header and assigned to param
Param stored in map and retrieved to bar, which is used in the XSS sink
bar passed to toCharArray() causing XSS vulnerability
